title: Lei n.o 4/2018 - Lei de Bases do Sistema Educativo
publisher: Assembleia Nacional / Diario da Republica de Sao Tome e Principe, copy held in ILO NATLEX
why_not: The enacting act of the SIGE, but the 50000-character capture ended at Article 49 and so does not reach Article 70, the article that creates the Sistema Integrado de Gestao Escolar; the held body therefore says nothing about the indicator, and the GPE sector compact was taken as baseline instead

title: A.T Especializada em Infraestruturas tecnologicas, gestao de recursos e capacitacao para implementacao do sistema integrado de gestao escolar (SIGE)
publisher: Agencia Fiduciaria de Administracao de Projetos (AFAP)
why_not: Fetch returned navigation chrome and a repeated title only, with no tender text; dropped as a headline-only stub, and the Tela Non republication of the same notice was staged in its place

title: DPSSF conclui Recertificacao do Cadastro Social Unico com atualizacao de dados de mais de 12 mil familias
why_not: Excluded by the cap: a substantial completed in-window event updating 12,560 households and expanding coverage from 8,000 to 12,000 families, but it is registry expansion and data quality rather than exchange with another government system, so the two World Bank documents were preferred on the indicator own terms

title: Government launches document issuance system at the Embassy of Sao Tome and Principe in Portugal
publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and Communities
why_not: Strong on the indicator, recording a DGRN digital portal letting the diaspora request birth certificates and the polycarbonate national identity card from data held in SIGA, but this is the English page and its body carries a visible machine-translation artefact; the Portuguese original under mne.gov.st/noticias/atualidades/ returned CRAWL_UNKNOWN_ERROR on fetch, so nothing was staged
